Understanding Fragrance Notes

Every perfume unfolds in three stages: top notes (the first impression), heart notes (the character), and base notes (the lasting signature).

Fragrance Concentrations

Extrait de Parfum (20-30% oil) offers the richest, longest-lasting experience. All Sixth Ritu fragrances are Extrait de Parfum.

How to Apply Perfume

Apply to pulse points — wrists, neck, behind the ears. Do not rub. Let the fragrance develop naturally on your skin.
